name: DNNE distributed deployables
description: Package groups for running the control program, WPF simulators, and brain structure services across separate machines.

deployables.name: machine1-control-avatar
deployables.description: Control Program plus the WPF world, editor, and maze simulators. Keep this on the interactive machine.

deployables.name: visual-perception
deployables.description: Retinal input, early visual cortex, visual feature/motion streams, and attentional orienting.

deployables.name: auditory
deployables.description: Cochlear and midbrain auditory pathway through primary auditory cortex.

deployables.name: body-motor-cerebellum
deployables.description: Somatosensory, vestibular, motor cortex, spinal, brainstem, and cerebellar timing/correction circuits.

deployables.name: memory-navigation
deployables.description: Medial temporal memory, contextual scene, and navigation circuits.

deployables.name: attention-language-executive
deployables.description: Prefrontal, thalamic, parietal, interhemispheric, language, and cortical association loops.

deployables.name: limbic-basal-homeostasis
deployables.description: Affect, motivation, basal ganglia action gating, homeostasis, and neuromodulatory circuits.
